zh.title: 倫敦蓋特威克機場夏季高峰停水 旅客設施受影響
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 與 BBC 的報導，倫敦蓋特威克機場於2026年7月26日（星期日）遭遇全園區自來水中斷，導致旅客廁所、餐飲及清潔服務無法正常運作。機場人員已派發瓶裝水、臨時廁所並啟動修復工程，盡快恢復供水。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 的報導，倫敦蓋特威克機場的旅客在2026年7月26日星期日遇到『乾燥的一天』，因為終端大樓的服務因自來水中斷而停止。
BBC 的報導指出，蓋特威克機場亦遭遇『running water outage』，同樣是在夏季旅遊高峰期間發生。
水中斷導致旅客廁所、餐飲攤位及清潔服務無法正常使用，旅客只能依賴機場臨時提供的瓶裝水與簡易廁所。
機場方面已啟動應變措施，派發瓶裝水、設置臨時衛生設施，並與承包商協調搶修供水管線，盡快恢復正常供水。

en.title: Gatwick Airport Experiences Water Outage During Peak Summer Travel
en.summary: According to reports from Simple Flying and the BBC, London Gatwick Airport suffered a complete loss of running water on Sunday, July 26, 2026, during the peak of the summer holiday season. The outage affected terminal restrooms, food outlets and cleaning services, leaving passengers without basic amenities. Airport officials said they have deployed bottled water distribution and are working with contractors to restore the water supply as quickly as possible.
body: Simple Flying reported that Gatwick's customers had a 'dry Sunday' as terminal services shut down due to a loss of running water.
The BBC also reported that Gatwick Airport was hit by a running water outage, occurring during the busy summer holiday period.
The water shortage prevented passengers from using restrooms, food outlets and cleaning services, forcing the airport to provide bottled water and temporary facilities.
Airport officials activated contingency plans, distributing bottled water, setting up temporary toilets, and working with contractors to repair the water supply system as swiftly as possible.
